assessment: In this study the authors examined the metabolomic profile of the rat hippocampus and report significant changes at various developmental ages at baseline and following episodic learning. Infants had the largest number of changes of hippocampal metabolites with many associated with the glutathione mediated antioxidant pathway. Infantile learning was shown to induce a rapid increase in glutathione reductase and inhibition of this enzyme impaired long term memory formation at this developmental age, but not in older animals, suggesting a key requirement for this pathway in infantile memory formation.
